readiness.hed: The weekend's rain and snow showers have cleared out, leaving a partly sunny Sunday near 55 in Fredericksburg before a sunny, mild start to the week
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this morning. Today stays partly sunny with a high near 55 and northwest wind gusting to 18 mph, then skies turn mostly cloudy overnight with a low around 33. Monday and Tuesday both turn sunny and milder, with highs near 58 and 62 and clear, cold nights down into the high 20s to low 30s — a dry, calmer stretch after the weekend system that brought scattered rain and snow showers through Saturday.
actions: Gusts to 18 mph this afternoon can still rattle loose trash cans, tarps and holiday decorations — a good morning to walk the yard and secure anything light.
Overnight lows near freezing tonight and again Monday and Tuesday nights — keep sensitive plants covered and check on exposed outdoor pipes.
Sunday through Tuesday is dry and clearing, a solid window for outdoor church events, yard work or travel before the next system arrives.
Morning temperatures near freezing midweek mean a scraper in the car and a coat for the kids at the bus stop are worth keeping handy.
